pr_title: Enable support for generic methods with IDIC
pr_body:
Fixes #88964

Create tests to validate scenario.

Support for NativeAOT is still blocked - see https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/72909.
pr_comments: @jkotas Since @davidwrighton is out, do you have any context on why generic methods would have not been supported with `ICastable`? I'm assuming we added the check in IDIC for historical reasons rather than anything intentional.

issue_context.title: IDynamicInterfaceCastable throws EntryPointNotFoundException when calling a generic method

review_comments:
`int` is the easy case because it does not involve shared generic code.

Could you please also add test cases that exercise shared generic code? ``<string>`, `<(string, int>`, etc.
I have the `DoubleGenericArg<string>(...)` below. Is that not sufficient? Happy to add more cases if desired though.
Ah ok, I have missed the second test here.
Can you also validate that `typeof(V) == typeof(string)` here? It will ensure that the hidden generic arg is correct.
